title: Failed append advances the shared file offset
mechanism: InodeHandle::write assigns *offset = size for O_APPEND before the fallible write_at and only skips the += len on error, so a write that faults at byte zero leaves the shared offset at EOF.
contract: write(2) with O_APPEND: a failed write must not move the shared file offset; the offset follows committed progress only.
observed: Asterinas moves the shared offset to EOF on an O_APPEND write that fails with EFAULT, so later reads through the description return EOF.
fix_refs: https://github.com/asterinas/asterinas/pull/3481 (open, third-party, head d4d1cd3a22ac68b2e56821f42f867cd4548b6cd6; covers AST-06 by inspection only)
